updates.detailed_summary_zh: 拥有超过250万用户的点对点（P2P）加密货币平台NoOnes，在政府制裁及由此产生的监管限制导致运营难以为继后，正在逐步停止运营。 此次关停表明，政府制裁可能迫使重要的加密货币平台退出市场，直接影响用户的交易能力。这也凸显了依赖传统金融服务的加密交易所面临的监管和地缘政治风险。 NoOnes在2026年初用户数突破250万，并已为用户服务了三年。在制裁以及金融和加密服务提供商的限制导致运营无法继续后，平台为用户开放了紧急退出窗口以提取资金。
updates.detailed_summary_en: NoOnes, a peer-to-peer crypto platform with over 2.5 million users, is winding down operations after government sanctions and resulting regulatory restrictions made continued operations unsustainable. This shutdown demonstrates how government sanctions can force significant crypto platforms out of business, directly affecting users' ability to trade. It underscores the regulatory and geopolitical risks facing crypto exchanges that depend on traditional financial services. NoOnes surpassed 2.5 million users earlier in 2026 and had served customers for three years. An emergency exit window was opened for users to withdraw funds after sanctions and restrictions from financial and crypto-service providers made operations impossible.
